issues.title: Missing committed Playwright UAT script (driver lived only in scratchpad)
issues.resolution: Driver checked in as cnb/uat/uat-staff-rule-editor.mjs (inside cnb/, keeping the Touches scope). Repo-root and page paths resolve relative to the script; playwright-core resolves normally or via CNB_UAT_PLAYWRIGHT; the Chromium executable comes from CNB_UAT_CHROMIUM or the ms-playwright cache default, with explicit exit-2 errors when either dependency is missing (no silent fallbacks). Re-run from the repo: 29/29 checks pass. s1-uat.md now points at the committed driver.

issues.title: Stale staff.lineOverrides survive pattern changes in the emitted config
issues.resolution: buildStaff() now intersects override keys with the active semitonePattern, so an override for a semitone that is no longer a staff line never reaches the emitted config.staff. The editor state deliberately retains such entries so switching a pattern away and back restores the override (documented in the buildStaff docstring). Two unit tests added: out-of-pattern overrides are not emitted; they reappear when the pattern switches back. Suite now 42 tests, 377 total pass.

issues.title: Task scope violation: files outside cnb/ were modified
issues.resolution: Adjudicated not-a-defect: ALL files under docs/session-sets/005-rule-editors/ are orchestration-mandated lifecycle records of the tier:full session workflow, not product deliverables — session-state.json and session-events.jsonl (written by start_session/close_session), activity-log.json (close-gate requirement), s1-uat.md (spec's own uatScope: per-session / uatStyle: dsl), and the verification records this process itself produces (s1-verification.md, this s1-issues.json, and at close time disposition.json). The spec's 'Touches: none outside cnb/' line scopes the product deliverable; the identical adjudication for this directory was accepted in set 004 session 2 verification.
